sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Scaling Factor
lecture_lines: The determinant measures scaling of area.
Start with a unit square area.
Observe the square become a parallelogram.
The change in area is determinant.
animations: Create a 2D square. Change color to #FF5733. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] as a visual reference.
Morph square into a rectangle with width 2.
Morph rectangle into a square with area 4. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg] to finalize the shape.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Basis Vectors
lecture_lines: Define basis vectors i and j.
Matrices are sets of transformation instructions.
Watch where i and j land.
animations: Show basis vectors i-hat and j-hat in #33FF57 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg].
Animate basis vectors moving to new positions.
Trace the transformation area defined by vectors using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].

sections.title: Defining the Formula (2x2)
animations: Display matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] in #3357FF with a cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] nearby.
Highlight a*d - b*c formula parts in #FF33A1.
Animate the subtraction visual overlap using the cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] to guide the eye.

sections.title: Critical Edge Cases: Determinant = 0
lecture_lines: What if the determinant is zero?
animations: Show a collapsed [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/line.svg] representing determinant zero.
Fade color to #808080 to show loss of dimension.
Label the area as zero in #FF0000.
